name: Self-Service Session Manager
description: Lists and revokes only the signed-in user's sessions without exposing credentials.

permissions.rationale: Display minimized creation, expiry, and active-state metadata for the signed-in user's sessions. Tokens, hashes, cookies, IP addresses, and user agents are not exposed.
Revoke a session selected by the signed-in user after host-owned confirmation. Other users' sessions cannot be addressed.
